<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_StorageManagement" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToReadOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToReadOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadOrderToSelectFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstProduct" name="Select first product from order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadOrderToSelectFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectFirstToStockMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock_Merge" name="Product to check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectFirstToStockMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectNextToStockMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StockMergeToStockSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock_Split" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_NotInStock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StockMergeToStockSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WithdrawToReadyMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReorderToArrived</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrived" name="Ordered product arrived">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReorderToArrived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArrivedToDelaySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delay_Split" name="Waited more than 10 days?" default="Flow_NoPenalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArrivedToDelaySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DelayedPenalty</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoPenalty</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DelayedPenalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PenaltyToDelayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delay_Merge" name="Delay handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PenaltyToDelayMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoPenalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DelayMergeToRegister</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DelayMergeToRegister</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterToReadyMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Merge" name="Product stock updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WithdrawToReadyMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterToReadyMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadyMergeToReadySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Split" name="Order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_NotReady">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadyMergeToReadySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ready</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectNextToStockMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Pack_Split" name="Start courier and packing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ready</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRequestCourier</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPackProducts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRequestCourier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CourierToPackJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPackProducts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackToPackJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Pack_Join" name="Courier and packing completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CourierToPackJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackToPackJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackJoinToShip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackJoinToShip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrderToSelectFirst" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectFirstToStockMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstProduct" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMergeToStockSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock_Split" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${productInStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock_Split" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WithdrawToReadyMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderToArrived" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivedToDelaySplit" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrived" targetRef="Gateway_Delay_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayedPenalty" name="More than 10 days" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay_Split" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${waitingDays > 10}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPenalty" name="10 days or less" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Delay_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PenaltyToDelayMerge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_Delay_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayMergeToRegister" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay_Merge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToReadyMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyMergeToReadySplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready" name="Ready for shipment" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Pack_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderReadyForShipment}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNextToStockMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_Pack_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_Pack_Split" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CourierToPackJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_Pack_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackToPackJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_Pack_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackJoinToShip" sourceRef="Gateway_Pack_Join" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
